whose.job: The defaults of this job's preset “{name}”. Apply replaces the job's {list} with what these defaults give; the preset changes only when you save into it.
whose.jobBuiltIn: The defaults of this job's preset “{name}”. Apply replaces the job's {list} with what these defaults give. “{name}” is built in and cannot be changed: Save as new preset… keeps these defaults in a new preset.
whose.preset: The defaults of the preset “{name}”. Jobs drafted with it from now on use what you save here.
whose.builtIn: “{name}” is a built-in preset: its defaults are shown read-only. Duplicate it in the presets list to change them.

ruled.audio: “{name}” has its own audio track rules. They decide the audio tracks instead of these defaults, so a change here changes no track until those rules are removed from the preset. The preview shows what the rules give.
ruled.subtitles: “{name}” has its own subtitle track rules. They decide the subtitle tracks instead of these defaults, so a change here changes no track until those rules are removed from the preset. The preview shows what the rules give.

confirm.title: Save into “{name}”?
confirm.audio: The audio defaults of “{name}” are replaced with these. Jobs drafted with it from now on use them; this job's tracks change only when you apply them.
confirm.subtitles: The subtitle defaults of “{name}” are replaced with these. Jobs drafted with it from now on use them; this job's tracks change only when you apply them.

save.failed: The defaults could not be saved in “{name}”

open.noPreset: The job's preset is not known, so its defaults cannot be shown

group.notBuilt: Defaults for a batch group are not built yet
group.notBuiltDetail: They come with batch editing. Open a single file, or edit a preset's defaults in the presets view.

fixFailed: The fix no longer fits these defaults

selection.title: Which tracks to take
selection.fromSettingsAudio: Use the preferred audio languages of Settings → Languages
selection.fromSettings: Use the preferred subtitle languages of Settings → Languages
selection.settingsAudio: The preferred audio languages of Settings → Languages
selection.settingsSubtitles: The preferred subtitle languages of Settings → Languages
selection.noneSet: Settings → Languages has none: every track is kept, in source order, and the settings below wait until a language is set.
selection.emptyList: An empty list uses the preferred languages of Settings → Languages too.
selection.tieBreak: If a language has several tracks
selection.tieBreakHelp: Best quality: lossless first, then the highest bitrate (an unknown bitrate last), then more channels.

undeterminedChoice.firstLanguage: Treat as the first listed language

defaultTrackChoice.firstInFirstLanguage: First track in the first language

rules.title: Codec rules
rules.intro: Each selected track takes the first rule that matches it, from the top. The last rule takes every track that no rule above takes.
rules.catchAllLocked: The last rule takes any language and any channels. It stays last and cannot be removed.
rules.added: Rule added above the last rule
rules.anyLanguageHint: No language: the rule takes any language.
rules.drcHelp: 0 is off; 1 to 4 make loud and quiet parts closer. A track that is compressed is encoded, never passed through.
rules.nameTemplateHelp: A name template: {'{'}lang_native{'}'}, {'{'}lang_name{'}'}, {'{'}channels{'}'}, {'{'}codec{'}'}, {'{'}bitrate{'}'}, {'{'}title{'}'}, {'{'}source_codec{'}'}. Empty: the source track's name.
rules.firstTrackOnly: Only for the first track of this language
rules.extraOutputsHelp: More tracks made from the same source track, for example an AAC stereo track for compatibility.

named.firstTrackOnly: Only for the first track of this language, in rule {n}
named.outputCodec: Codec of extra output {output} of rule {n}
named.outputMixdown: Mixdown of extra output {output} of rule {n}
named.outputBitrate: Bitrate of extra output {output} of rule {n}

passthru.title: Passthru and fallback
passthru.fallbackHelp: Encodes a track whose rule says Passthru when its codec is not allowed or the container cannot hold it.

subtitles.title: Foreign audio and burn-in
subtitles.foreignAudioSearchHelp: When the audio is in your first subtitle language, take that language's forced subtitles (for the parts in another language). The track goes first and gets the forced flag.
subtitles.burnInHelp: At most one track is burned into the picture; a burned-in track is not copied.

burnInChoice.foreignAudioThenFirst: Foreign audio subtitles, else the first track

preview.title: Preview
preview.noSource: Open a source file to see what these defaults do with its tracks.
preview.failed: The preview could not be made: {detail}
preview.noAudio: The source has no audio tracks.
preview.noSubtitles: The source has no subtitle tracks.
preview.measureHelp: The bitrate is unknown and decides what the rule does: measure it to see the real outcome.
